The memo: -

Reference No. 1 to the prescribed procedure to be followed before payment of salary and non-salaried dues of teachers / non-teaching staff in Special Non-Government Schools / Workshops for Persons with Disabilities. Directions have been issued vide Government Circular No. 1 dated 02.01.2026, to examine and submit proposals as per the prescribed Scrutiny List.

Accordingly, as per the proposal of The New Education Society, Kolhapur and Vinay Kumar Madan Mohan Lohia Deaf School, Kolhapur District Kolhapur, received by the Department from the Commissioner, Divyang Kalyan, Pune, the following funds are being disbursed for grant-in-aid (Programme), 31-Auxiliary Grants (Non-Salary) to Non-Governmental Organizations working for persons with speech impairment.
